---
title: "convert"
---

This command converts a VCF (variant call format) file to a TSV (tab-separated values) file. Please refer to the [Variants TSV](variants_tsv_file.qmd) for more information on the headers found in a `Exacto` converted TSV file.

<div style="background-color:#f8f8f8; padding:12px; font-family: monospace, monospace;">
<pre>
usage: exacto convert [-h] 

</pre>
</div>

| Required Parameter | Description |
| ----- | -------- |
| `--` |           |


### Notes on Variant Types

#### Deletions
For `DEL` (deletion), `pos_1` is the start position of the deletion (i.e. the first position of the deleted DNA segment) and `pos_2` is the end position of the deletion (i.e. the last position of the deleted DNA segment). In other words, the DNA segment from `pos_1` to `pos_2` (inclusive) corresponds to the deleted DNA segment.
